chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى الْعَلَاءُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.en: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ.

translations.en: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Whoever is killed defending his wealth is a martyr.”

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ: وَ قَالَ: لَوْ كُنْتُ أَنَا لَتَرَكْتُ الْمَالَ وَ لَمْ أُقَاتِلْ.

translations.en: He said: “And he said: If it were me, I would have left the wealth and not fought.”

en.summary: This hadith states that one who is killed while defending his property attains the status of a martyr. At the same time, the Imam عليه السلام indicates a preference for avoiding bloodshed and abandoning wealth rather than engaging in combat over it.
en.seo_question: Is a person who is killed defending his wealth considered a martyr in Islam?

key_terms.دُونَ مَالِهِ: in defense of his wealth or property
key_terms.شَهِيدٌ: one granted the rank of martyr
key_terms.لَتَرَكْتُ الْمَالَ: I would have abandoned the wealth
key_terms.وَ لَمْ أُقَاتِلْ: and I would not have fought
